critic.fix_suggestion: Extend the upper-deck primitive along its longitudinal axis to increase 'Hump length'. Specifically, move the rear vertex of the upper deck backward until it spans 60% of the forward fuselage length. Simultaneously, scale the vertical height of this same primitive by a factor of 1.5 to address the low profile and widen the lateral span to 85% of the main fuselage width. Finally, apply a fillet radius of 2.0 units to the front edge where it meets the cockpit to smooth the transition curvature.

discrepancies.observed: A very short hump that ends almost immediately behind the cockpit.
discrepancies.reference: An elongated upper deck that extends significantly further back along the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: The hump is relatively flat and low compared to the main fuselage diameter.
discrepancies.reference: A prominent, high-profile upper deck that rises significantly above the main cabin line.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase vertical height of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: The transition from the cockpit to the hump is abrupt and lacks a smooth curve.
discrepancies.reference: A gradual, aerodynamic curve blending the nose into the upper deck.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: smooth/round the front edge of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears narrow and thin relative to the fuselage width.
discrepancies.reference: A wide upper deck that spans a significant portion of the forward fuselage width.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase width of the upper-deck primitive
